_about: gamma-Valerolactone (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of gamma-valerolactone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of gamma-valerolactone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: D. Havasi, G. Patzay, Z. Kolarovszki, L. T. Mika, Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibria for Binary Mixtures of .gamma.-Valerolactone + Methanol, Ethanol, and 2-Propanol, J. Chem. Eng. Data 61 (2016) 3326-3333
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9, 10. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0009. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.24 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
